summary: Opt-in browser smoke and performance workflows, run by native Node 24 using the shared scripts/e2e/harness.ts. Web source checks include these scripts under the existing tsconfig scope; syntax checking and full browser execution remain separate.
artifact_boundary: host-artifacts loads prebuilt local-api artifacts by dynamic URL and checks required callable exports. Test-side consumer ports avoid stale generated declarations; full execution still requires a prepared Host build.
